on.name: update_balance
on.doc: Triggered when account balance information is updated.

on.name: update_history_new_fast
on.doc: Triggered when fast historical market data is received.

on.name: update_close_value
on.doc: Triggered when real-time price stream values are updated.

on.name: update_opened_deals
on.doc: Triggered when the list of opened deals is updated.

on.name: success_open_deal
on.doc: Triggered after a new deal is successfully opened.

on.name: update_closed_deals
on.doc: Triggered when closed deals information is updated.

on.name: update_assets
on.doc: Triggered when available trading assets metadata is updated.

on.name: success_close_deal
on.doc: Triggered after one or more deals are successfully closed.

on.name: connect
on.doc: Triggered when the Socket.IO connection is established.

on.name: disconnect
on.doc: Triggered when the Socket.IO connection is closed.

on.name: change_market_sentiment
on.doc: Triggered when market sentiment data is updated.

emit.name: ps
emit.doc: Sends a heartbeat request to keep the connection alive.

emit.name: indicator_load
emit.doc: Indicates that indicator data has been loaded by the platform.

emit.name: favorite_load
emit.doc: Indicates that favorite has been loaded by the platform.

emit.name: price_alert_load
emit.doc: Indicates that price alert data has been loaded by the platform.

args.name: data
args.doc: Authorization payload containing session and account information.

emit.name: subscribe_to_asset
emit.doc: Subscribes to real-time updates for a trading asset.

emit.name: subscribe_for_market_sentiment
emit.doc: Subscribes to market sentiment updates for an asset.

emit.name: unsubscribe_for_market_sentiment
emit.doc: Removes market sentiment subscription for an asset.

args.name: asset
args.doc: Trading asset to remove from sentiment tracking.

emit.name: change_asset
emit.doc: Changes the active trading asset and timeframe.

emit.name: copy_signal
emit.doc: Creates a deal from a copy trading signal.
